metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the sixpence book, the first couplet, the Verona page, and the cat on it.

yesterday: Brooke cost sixpence. It wants the last leaf but one.
The page is notes on Verona. Two names are struck. You stopped where the King comes first.
The last line you wrote is that it is not yet, and that the King comes first. The foot has the book at sixpence.
Gib has the right-hand page. Tomorrow is still fish. The sheet from Anne stays where you left it.
